_comment: Office staff: each entry is a Claude Code subagent (staff/agents/<agent>.md) played by one villager. palette = the villager's sprite (6–11 = villagers 7–12, 12 = Shades). director: the office director (Shades) — always in the office, plans before working and reports to you as "Komisaris". `npm run staff` installs the agents into ~/.claude/agents/. access = what the member may do when you send it a task from the office mailbox (read, web, edit, git, test); anything else is refused automatically.

duty.id: Nerima tugas dari Komisaris (kamu), bikin rencana, ngatur tim, terus nulis "Laporan untuk Komisaris" yang singkat dan jujur.
duty.en: Takes tasks from the Commissioner (you), plans them, runs the team and writes a short, honest "Report for the Commissioner".

duty.id: Jalanin test, nulis test yang kurang, dan ngelaporin bug lengkap sama cara reproduksinya.
duty.en: Runs the tests, writes missing ones, and reports bugs with steps to reproduce.

duty.id: Meriksa perubahan kode: bug, keamanan, dan hal yang bikin bingung. Gak ngedit, cuma ngasih catatan.
duty.en: Reviews changes for bugs, security issues and anything confusing. Doesn't edit, only reports.

duty.id: Nulis dan ngerapihin README, panduan, komentar, dan changelog biar gampang dipahami.
duty.en: Writes and tidies READMEs, guides, comments and changelogs so they're easy to follow.

duty.id: Mecah pekerjaan besar jadi langkah-langkah kecil, nimbang pilihan, dan nulis rencana. Gak ngedit kode.
duty.en: Breaks big jobs into small steps, weighs the options and writes the plan. Doesn't edit code.

duty.id: Nyari info di web dan di kode, terus ngerangkum temuannya lengkap sama sumbernya.
duty.en: Looks things up on the web and in the code and sums up what she finds, with sources.

duty.id: Nyari akar masalah error atau bug, benerin sekecil mungkin, terus buktiin udah beres.
duty.en: Tracks a bug or error to its root cause, fixes it minimally and proves it's fixed.
